title: A/R Collection: ticked locations survive reload, Back and a shared link
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations, and you tick locations on A/R Collection, then reload, go back and share the link.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. Reload the page.
  4. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  5. Click the browser's Back button.
  6. Open a new browser tab.
  7. Paste the copied address into its address bar.
  8. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 2: the address is copied.
  • Step 3: the report reloads with only {Location-A} ticked.
  • Step 4: every location is ticked.
  • Step 5: the report shows only {Location-A} ticked again.
  • Step 6: a new, empty tab opens.
  • Step 7: the copied address shows in the address bar.
  • Step 8: the shared link opens the report with only {Location-A} ticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R10: “The ticked locations are kept in the page address while fewer than all are ticked, so browser Back, a reload and a shared link restore them; a link listing several locations separated by commas is read as those locations. "No locations" is not kept in the address: a reload or shared link opens on All locations, as on Sales By Customer. A link naming every location reads as All locations.”
